tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background for menus, home, setup, settings and sheets' backdrop.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, list rows, cards in menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: segmented-control track, input fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows; decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface and surface-raised (≥5.4:1 light, ≥5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: table
tokens.usage: Felt green table surface — the recommended default. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: table-raised
tokens.usage: Meld zones, seat plates and the chat panel on the green table.

tokens.name: table-line
tokens.usage: Empty meld-zone outlines and dividers on the table; decorative only.

tokens.name: table-alt
tokens.usage: Blue-grey table surface, the alternative felt colour in Settings.

tokens.name: table-alt-raised
tokens.usage: Meld zones and seat plates on the blue-grey table.

tokens.name: table-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on table, table-raised, table-alt (≥10:1).

tokens.name: table-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the table: counts, captions, the rule-mode tag (≥5.3:1 on table-raised).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card face — off-white, never pure white; slightly dimmer in dark mode to avoid glare.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: Card border, separates overlapping cards in a fan.

tokens.name: card-ink
tokens.usage: Spades and clubs (standard deck), indices of jokers, on card.

tokens.name: card-red
tokens.usage: Hearts and diamonds (standard deck); hearts in the four-colour deck. ≥4.9:1 on card.

tokens.name: card-blue
tokens.usage: Diamonds in the four-colour deck, on card.

tokens.name: card-green
tokens.usage: Clubs in the four-colour deck, on card (4.55:1 on the dark-mode card).

tokens.name: card-back
tokens.usage: Card back field (stock, mortos, opponents' hands).

tokens.name: card-back-pattern
tokens.usage: Fine lattice on the card back; decorative.

tokens.name: wild
tokens.usage: Wild-card marker (2s and jokers) on card: a corner notch, never text. ≥3.3:1 as a mark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, the active-turn glow, selected-card outline, focus on the table.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (8.4:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent used as text, links and the focus ring on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: team-a
tokens.usage: Team A (“Nós”) on the table: score chip mark, meld-zone label, canastra frame. Always paired with the circle mark.

tokens.name: team-b
tokens.usage: Team B (“Eles”) on the table. Always paired with the diamond mark; blue/orange stays apart under colour-blindness.

tokens.name: team-a-ink
tokens.usage: Team A as text on surface-raised (round summary, game over).

tokens.name: team-b-ink
tokens.usage: Team B as text on surface-raised.

tokens.name: valid
tokens.usage: Valid selection outline and the “can meld” hint on the table. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: valid-ink
tokens.usage: Valid state as text on surface-raised.

tokens.name: invalid
tokens.usage: Invalid-selection reason on the table. Always with words; never shakes.

tokens.name: invalid-ink
tokens.usage: Invalid/destructive text on surface-raised (delete account).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind sheets and the chat panel.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only, on Sign in and the splash. Never for UI.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts and metadata. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Score chips on the table. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: score-lg
styles.usage: Round summary and game over totals. Tabular figures.

styles.name: card-index-sm
styles.usage: Rank index on table-size cards in melds.

styles.name: card-court
styles.usage: Centre letter on J, Q, K faces.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a card index and its suit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between table zones; list row inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; card and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large separation, top of sheets.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on Sign in and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Table-size cards, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Hand-size and pile cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, meld zones, list groups, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets (top corners) and the chat panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Score chips, toggles, quick-phrase chips, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card-lift
tokens.usage: Selected or moving card.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and the chat panel.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target, every control.

tokens.name: card-hand-w
tokens.usage: Hand card width on phone (82px tall, 1:1.41).

tokens.name: card-hand-h
tokens.usage: Hand card height on phone.

tokens.name: card-table-w
tokens.usage: Meld card width on phone.

tokens.name: card-table-h
tokens.usage: Meld card height on phone.

tokens.name: card-pile-w
tokens.usage: Stock and discard pile card width.

tokens.name: card-pile-h
tokens.usage: Stock and discard pile card height.

tokens.name: select-lift
tokens.usage: How far a selected hand card rises.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled cards (not playable now) and disabled controls.
